changes: QPER links any number of performances again. Hold PERF: a knob, PLAY, STOP and YES act on all linked ones at once.
Hold FIX or CHRO and press PLAY to set all the sound's velocity or aftertouch links to 0; PLAY again undoes.
Hold LFO and press PLAY, RECORD or STOP on any page to clear, copy or paste the LFO page.
Recorded scene changes go to the nearest step when LIVE RECORDING is quantized; performance moves stay as played.
RECORD + YES no longer stalls on a take with many scene locks, and waits for the loop start when it must lengthen a track while playing.
Hold PERF and turn a knob to lock QPER's linked performance; YES, PLAY, RECORD and STOP apply, clear, copy and paste it.
QPER keeps only its link (QPER + a pad); its other gestures are stock's again.
Hold CHRO and turn a knob to link aftertouch; SAMPLER is stock's again.
SCENE + YES writes the scene into the kit; YES again undoes. With SCENE or PERF held, PLAY no longer starts the sequencer.
LIVE RECORDING keeps scene changes too: RECORD + YES writes them as locks, RECORD + NO clears them.
Now called Improved Modulation, and QPER Live Rec is part of it: QPER locks, copy, paste, clear, YES and the quick perf rec work as before.
Press QPER + YES again in the same hold to undo the apply; SCENE + REC, STOP or PLAY reacts sooner, at once in scene edit.
QPER Live Rec leaves the library: install this module in its place, never both.
Now called Improved Mod Assign. Hold SCENE and turn a knob to lock it in the scene, also in scene edit.
SCENE + knob press removes a lock; SCENE + REC, STOP or PLAY copies, pastes or clears the scene.
SCENE held and let go with no knob opens scene edit as before, now on the release.
With no scene engaged the locks go to the scene engaged last; tap pads while holding SCENE to lock other tracks.
Holding LFO on the LFO page shows its values in PERF, SCNE, MUTE and CHRO too, as on stock.
Takes less of the RAM all modules share, so more modules fit beside it. No change to how it works or sounds.
Hold FIX, SAMPLER or LFO for about half a second just to look at the amounts: letting go then does nothing.
A quick tap still toggles fixed velocity, opens the recorder or opens the LFO page.
With LFO held, a MIDI turn passed to stock's locker by a module now sets the LFO's depth too, not only the Rytm's knobs.
Now called Quick Mod Assign.
Hold LFO and turn a knob: that parameter becomes the LFO's destination; keep turning to set the depth.
With LFO held, pressing the destination's knob sets the depth back to 0.
An LFO tap opens the LFO page on the release, as FIX now toggles on the release.
Other mods that follow the page keys now see that LFO tap too.
First release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74: hold FIX and turn a knob to link that parameter to velocity.
Hold SAMPLER and turn a knob to link it to aftertouch.
While held, linked knobs show their amounts like performance locks.
Uses the sound's own four velocity and four aftertouch slots, so links save with the kit.
A FIX tap now toggles fixed velocity when you let go.
